reviews.comment: She is the sweetest, the class itself is quite easy. The STAT department make all the exams except the final which she makes super easy. She most definitely wants her students to succeed. 3 Exams total, and quizzes in class that she literally gives answers for. And she lowers her grade cutoffs to 89 for A.  You also have 3 extra credit % points!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is insanely hard. The pre-reqs are high school math, but get ready for confusing and difficult lessons and tests. I've done well in other maths, got an A in calc, but got a B here. You can tell the teacher cares, but it's not enough to carry the students. Class averaged failing grades for the 2nd exam, so they added extra credit
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You can tell that she's a sweet lady, but I personally was unable to learn much from her. The way she taught the material (reading directly from the slides) was not engaging at all, and it made the already complicated math even more confusing. One good thing is that she gave extra credit on the final and to your overall grade.

Xiyu Peng is the sweetest stats professor ever. She is very caring and explains concepts well. Exams are heavily weighted but they are not super hard if you study. First two exams are common exams and the final is made by her. I thought she made the final easier than the first two exams and gave us lots of extra credit!
